title: Business Name Registration (Western Provincial Council)
authority: Department of Business Names (Western Provincial Council)
source_text: Every individual or firm carrying on business under a business name in the Western Province shall register such business name with the Registrar of Business Names within 14 days of establishment.

title: Local Authority Trade Tax & Annual Operating Permit
authority: Local Municipal Council / Urban Council (Western Province)
source_text: Any person carrying on any trade, business, or commercial profession within municipal limits shall pay the prescribed annual trade tax and obtain a valid operating license.

title: CMC Food Premises Hygiene Licence & Commercial Kitchen Clearance
source_text: No person shall manufacture, prepare, package, store, or sell any food for public consumption unless the premises and kitchen facilities comply with prescribed hygienic standards.
documents_needed: Kitchen & Food Preparation Facility Layout Plan
Water Quality Potability Lab Test Report
Pest Control & Waste Disposal Management Contract

title: PHI Food Handler Health Clearance & Medical Fitness Certificate
authority: Office of the Medical Officer of Health (MOH) / PHI
source_text: Every employee or person engaged in handling food or culinary utensils shall undergo periodic medical examination and obtain a valid fitness certificate issued by the Public Health Inspector.

title: Cosmetic & Chemical Handling Sanitary Registration
authority: National Medicines Regulatory Authority (NMRA) & Municipal Health Dept
source_text: Establishments offering hair, nail, or aesthetic beauty services utilizing chemical hair dyes, perming solutions, or skin bleaching agents shall secure sanitary clearance and verify NMRA registration of all applied cosmetics.
documents_needed: Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for Chemical Agents Used

title: CEA Environmental Protection Clearance for Waste Oil & Battery Storage
source_text: Any business storing, distributing, or retailing automotive spare parts that generates scheduled waste such as spent lead-acid batteries or used mineral oil shall secure prescribed environmental clearance.
documents_needed: Hazardous Waste / Spent Battery Storage Layout Plan

title: Commercial Garment Retail & Trade Safety Permit
source_text: Any premises engaged in the retail distribution or bulk storage of garments and textiles must maintain certified firefighting equipment and obtain a commercial trade permit.
